sources.note: Adam Hall listing of the Neutrik NC5MXX (5-pole male XLR cable connector, DMX): diameter 19 mm, length 70.1 mm (a second retailer, Tanotis, quotes 0.75 in / 19 mm and 68.1 - 70.1 mm). The NC5MXX uses the same housing as the NC3MXX, so the box is the NC3MXX box (20.3 x 20.3 x 69.6 mm, the manufacturer STEP bounding box of the NC3MXX): an assumption, the NC5MXX drawing itself was not opened.

Pin layout of the 5-pole plug: an arc of five pins 45 degrees apart on about a 4.6 mm radius over the lower half, the key and latch on top; read from the general XLR5 (DMX512, ANSI E1.11) pinout drawing, not measured on a drawing of this connector: an estimate.
